headline: Nicolas CAGE 🏠 Driveway COLLAPSES 🌋 Into 30FT Sinkhole 🕳️
text:
NICOLAS 🧔 CAGE'S 🏡 driveway 🛣️ COLLAPSED 💥 into a MASSIVE 🌋 sinkhole 🕳️ right outside 🏠 his Malibu 🏖️ mansion 🏰 after DAYS 🌧️ of heavy rain ☔ pounded southern California 🌴!! The crater 🕳️ measures a whopping 30FT 📏 by 30FT 📐 and swallowed 🚫 most of the home's 🏡 driveway 🛣️ leaving broken asphalt 🪨 concrete 🧱 and construction debris 🏗️ scattered inside 🕳️ the hole 🌊!! Local media 📺 reported no injuries 🤕 at all 🙅‍♂️ while BBC 📰 has reached out 📞 to Cage's 🧔 reps 👔 for comment 💬 but so far 🤷 nothing 🦗!! The Oscar 🏆 winner bought 🛍️ the property 🏠 in 2024 📅 according to the New York Times 🗞️ shortly after the sale 💰 and residents 🏘️ nearby said an 8FT 🕳️ sinkhole started forming on Monday 📅.

At first 🕒 the homeowners 🏠 were not overly concerned 😌 one resident 🏘️ told Los Angeles magazine 📖 saying they thought 🧠 it could be fixed 🔧 pretty quickly ⚡ but then suddenly 🌩️ all hell 🔥 broke loose 😱 when further ground 🪨 gave way 🌋 in the early hours 🌙 of Tuesday 🗓️ leaving a full 30FT 🕳️ crater 🕳️ that just ATE 🍽️ the driveway 🛣️!! Emergency services 🚨 rushed 🚨 in when the structural failure 💥 caused a gas leak ⛽ and SoCalGas 🏭 later confirmed ✅ the leak had been secured 🔒 with traffic cones 🛑 now surrounding the massive hole 🕳️!! Waves 🌊 from the pounding sea 🌊 can be seen lapping 🏄‍♂️ into the hole 🕳️ and rushing 💦 out again under the stanchions 🏗️ that support the home 🏠 after a coastal flooding warning 🚨 was issued tied to Tropical Storm Marie 🌀 which used to be a full hurricane 🌪️ bringing rain 🌧️ and high waves 🌊 to Southern California 🌴.

Malibu city officials 👮 have declared at least five homes 🏠 on the street 🛣️ unsafe ❌ for entry 🚪 and warned residents 🏘️ that emergency access 🚨 is severely constrained ⛓️ with the area possibly impassable 🚫 due to the large portion of road 🛣️ that has collapsed 💥 following the wild weather 🌧️!! Nicolas Cage 🧔 who won an Oscar 🏆 for Leaving Las Vegas 🎰 is also known for films 🎥 like Gone in 60 Seconds ⏰ Face Off 😷 Con Air ✈️ Pig 🐷 Moonstruck 🌕 and The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent 💪 pictured recently 📸 at the Spider Noir premiere 🕷️ back in May 📅!! Nearby neighbors 🏘️ initially thought the 8FT 🕳️ hole could be patched 🩹 fast but then the ground just opened up 🌋 swallowing everything and leaving construction debris 🏗️ broken asphalt 🪨 and concrete chunks 🧱 down in the crater 🕳️ with gas leak ⛽ crews scrambling to contain it all!!

The sinkhole 🕳️ estimated at 30FT 📏 by 30FT 📐 appeared after the driveway 🛣️ collapsed following days of torrential rain 🌧️ across southern California 🌴 with no injuries 🤕 reported anywhere 🙌 and BBC 📰 still waiting on word from Cage's 🧔 team 👥!! Waves 🌊 keep lapping 🏄 into the hole 🕳️ and rushing back out 💦 beneath the home's supports 🏠 while traffic cones 🛑 block off the scene 🎬 and officials 👮 have marked multiple properties 🏠 as unsafe ❌ with emergency routes 🚨 now heavily limited ⛔!! Cage 🧔 scooped up the Malibu 🏖️ pad 🏡 in 2024 📅 per the New York Times 🗞️ right after the sale 💵 and the collapse 💥 happened during Tropical Storm Marie's 🌀 onshore effects 🌊 after it had been a hurricane 🌪️ earlier!! One resident 🏘️ admitted they weren't too worried 😌 at the first 8FT 🕳️ signs but then everything went full apocalypse 🌋 mode when the bigger crater 🕳️ formed overnight 🌙 swallowing the driveway 🛣️ and causing a gas leak ⛽ that crews fixed 🔧 by Tuesday morning 🌅.

Emergency responders 🚨 arrived in the early hours 🌙 after the structural failure 💥 triggered the leak ⛽ with SoCalGas 🏭 confirming it was secured 🔐 while AFP 📸 noted the ocean waves 🌊 visibly entering and exiting the sinkhole 🕳️ under the house supports 🏠!! At least five homes 🏠 on the street have been declared unsafe ❌ with access severely constrained 🚧 and the road 🛣️ partly collapsed 🕳️ making the area nearly impassable 🛑 for now!! Nicolas Cage 🧔 the legendary actor 🎬 famous for Leaving Las Vegas 🎰 and massive hits like Con Air ✈️ remains silent 🤐 so far with his reps 👔 yet to comment 💬 on the dramatic driveway disaster 🏚️ that followed the heavy rain 🌧️ from Tropical Storm Marie 🌀 which hammered Southern California 🌴 with high surf 🌊 and flooding warnings 🚨!! The 30FT crater 🕳️ full of debris 🪨 now sits where the driveway 🛣️ used to be with cones 🛑 keeping everyone back while the sea 🌊 keeps playing peekaboo 👀 in and out of the hole 🌊 under the stanchions 🏗️ holding up the celebrity crib 🏡.
